LanguageData.RTE_Settings_AI_Note:
Note:
1. System automatically takes colony snapshots at midnight (buildings, rooms, blueprints).
2. AI compares with yesterday's snapshot, combines player action logs, project progress, research status, and events to generate brief summary.
3. Summary results display in 'History Snapshots' tab, won't directly modify overview.
4. If 'Auto-inject' is enabled, AI will automatically see recent history (with dates) during dialogue.
5. Project info: Reads in-progress and completed projects from status board.
6. Research status: Includes current research, completed research, optionally includes unfinished research (default off to save tokens).
